 "description": "Explores the foundations of human-centered AI. Examines the critical processes underpinning AI development and deployment and applies user-centered design principles to AI-driven products and services. Investigates methodologies for integrating human perspectives into AI systems and strategies for fostering collaboration between AI technologies and human users. Analyzes the ethical implications of AI applications in various organizational contexts using case studies showcasing the diverse uses of AI across business processes and products. Offers students an opportunity to engage in hands-on projects to design AI solutions tailored to human needs and that use AI systems responsibly to prioritize human values and well-being.
